Students admitted to ASU under the Western Undergraduate Exchange, or WUE, program in spring 2026 or earlier will continue to receive the WUE tuition rate for the duration of their undergraduate program.
Students must maintain continuous enrollment and meet renewal criteria.
https://admission.asu.edu/cost-aid/wue/maintaining-eligibility
The ASU Commitment Scholarship is designed for nonresident students to make an ASU degree more accessible to students nationwide.
Open to first-year, out-of-state (not Arizona) U.S. citizens, regardless of their state of residency, campus choice or major.
This is a renewable scholarship.
Available to out-of-state students enrolled in any degree program on the Phoenix-area campuses, as well as the ASU California Center in Los Angeles.
Can be combined with the New American University Scholarship.

Transfer students are not eligible for the ASU Commitment Scholarship. However, out-of-state transfer students can be automatically considered for a New American University Scholarship upon admission.
You must have a minimum 3.0 cumulative transfer GPA for scholarship consideration.
Scholarship amounts vary based on GPA.
https://tuition.asu.edu/asu-commitment-scholarship
